HEIF image conversion: third-party notices and corresponding source

This application uses heic-to 1.6.7 by Hopper Gee, distributed under
LGPL-3.0 (the installed LICENSE permits version 3 or any later version).
The library and its use are covered by that license. It is loaded on demand
through heic-to/csp; the upstream library has not been modified.
License: ./heic-to-LICENSE.txt
Source, including browser wrapper, embedded decoder and build instructions:
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/78345a3fcdb4a1d70d513fce2646aeff0127f7ba
Source archive:
https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/archive/78345a3fcdb4a1d70d513fce2646aeff0127f7ba.tar.gz

The decoder embeds libheif 1.23.7 and libde265 1.0.16, by their respective
upstream authors and contributors. Both libraries are distributed under
the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3. Their COPYING files
below include the LGPL and the incorporated GNU GPL version 3 text.

libheif 1.23.7:
License and upstream licensing notices: ./libheif-COPYING.txt
Source: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/tree/v1.23.7
Archive: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/archive/refs/tags/v1.23.7.tar.gz

libde265 1.0.16:
License and upstream licensing notices: ./libde265-COPYING.txt
Source: https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.0.16
Archive: https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.16.tar.gz

These libraries are provided without warranty, including without implied
warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose; see
the accompanying license texts for their terms.

Application integration is in frontend/src/lib/heifAttachment.ts and
frontend/src/lib/promptAttachments.ts in the accompanying application source.
To use a modified compatible library, replace the heic-to package with your
modified build, retain the heic-to/csp export, and rebuild the frontend using
its package scripts in a separate development checkout. The application does
not restrict modification of these libraries or reverse engineering for
debugging those modifications. Preserve these notices when redistributing.
